response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_pd FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pd) AS m FROM per_rating WHERE avg_pd IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pd) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(p.avg_pd - o.m) AS avg_excess FROM per_rating p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_pd > o.m
